note_complementaire: 1750 -> 1000 MW (Tihange 3 LTO; ICEDD). New nuclear delayed by five years: the central's 2045 step (0.5 GW large + 0.25 GW SMR on top of Tihange 3) arrives in 2050 and the 3 GW of 2050 in 2055, outside the horizon. TIMES builds exactly that (RW nuclear 1.045 GW in 2045, 1.795 GW in 2050). ICEDD's file gives 2050 min 1030 / max 1750; the floor is raised to the cap because TIMES imposes the build, as the central imposes its 2045 step (min = max 1750). The September override had pinned 1000/1000 from the brief and was never reconciled with ICEDD's file. Flanders is unchanged and the BE parent row is BEVLG + BEWAL (add_CCL_constraints subtracts the BEWAL row from BE). docs/logs/2026-09-30_cabinet_batch_20260930_2010_1h.md §2.6.
